items.q: Who is eligible for a refund?
items.a: Only courses advertised or confirmed as having a Money-Back Guarantee. You must attend the first scheduled live session and request the refund within 24 hours of completing it.

items.q: When does the 24-hour refund window start?
items.a: It starts when your first scheduled live session ends, not when you first contacted us.

items.q: What if I skip the first session or join a later batch?
items.a: Refund eligibility may be lost if you miss the first session, attend a later one, or shift to another batch.

items.q: Can I get a refund for personal reasons?
items.a: Generally no. Changes in career plans, job, time, relocation, finances or interest do not qualify for a refund.

items.q: Does using the LMS or downloading material affect my refund?
items.a: Yes. Watching recordings, downloading material or substantially using the learning platform can make a request ineligible, and we may check access logs.

items.q: Is a course without a Money-Back Guarantee refundable?
items.a: No. Unless a refund is stated in your offer, invoice or written agreement, the fee is non-refundable after payment confirmation.

items.q: Does a stopped attendance mean a refund?
items.a: No. Not attending, or not completing assignments, does not by itself qualify for a refund.

items.q: What about EMI or financing payments?
items.a: Refunds follow the financing provider's terms. Interest, convenience fees and processing charges already incurred may not be refundable.

items.q: I paid twice by mistake. What do I do?
items.a: Contact us as soon as possible. After checking, a duplicate payment may be refunded or adjusted, subject to gateway charges.

items.q: How do I request a refund?
items.a: Send your full name, registered email, phone number, course name, enrolment date, payment or transaction ID, payment date and reason, plus anything else we ask for. Submitting a request does not guarantee approval.

items.q: What if eBuddha Digitech cancels or reschedules my batch?
items.a: We will try to offer an alternative batch, a revised schedule or an online or offline option. If we cannot deliver the course at all, an appropriate refund or alternative may be given.

items.q: Where can I ask more questions?
